title: Vulkan Renderer Harness Case
description: One case manifest under tools/cases/<suite>/<case>.case.json. The same manifest drives the profile, snapshot, and autotest subcommands of vkr_harness; they differ only in which verdict policy they apply.

suite.description: Suite this case belongs to. Must match the containing directory.

scene.description: Repository-relative path below assets/scenes. Runtime validation also resolves the path under the repository root and requires the file to exist.

seed.description: Seed for every harness-owned pseudo-random decision.

resolution.description: Render target extent in pixels. Fill-bound passes scale with it, so it is part of the comparison config.

boot.description: Subsystem initialization profile. 'automation' is dependency-resolved from the workload and capture requirements; it does not itself imply a windowless target.

target.description: Output target and window visibility. 'offscreen' creates no window, surface, or swapchain.

present.description: Requested windowed present mode, or 'none' for offscreen. Runtime validation records and verifies the actual selected mode.

target_image_count.description: Requested offscreen image count. Windowed image count is selected by WSI and reported as actual configuration.

cache.description: GPU pipeline-cache policy only. Isolated modes use a per-run pipeline path and never mutate the user's ordinary pipeline cache. All modes and repetitions share the persistent build/_asset_cache root.

fixed_delta.description: Simulation timestep in seconds. Drives camera advancement. Wall-clock is measured for timing metrics but never fed back into scene state.

warmup.description: Exact frames rendered and discarded after the separate asset-readiness/pipeline-prewarm gate. Stability failure invalidates the run; it does not extend this phase and shift camera time.

repetitions.description: Independent child processes. An execution profile may raise this value to its authoritative minimum.

repetition_timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock timeout for each child process.

asset_ready_timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for every scene-requested resource to report ready before failing the run. Exceeding it is a run failure, never a silent capture of a partially loaded scene.

speed.description: Scales authored camera time with fixed multipliers slow=0.5, medium=1, fast=2.

renderer.description: Renderer features that affect graph topology, work volume, or pixels. The effective dependency-resolved subsystem mask is reported separately.

text_fixture.description: Creates deterministic system-font, bitmap, and MTSDF UI text before scene activation.

taa_enabled.description: Enables temporal reconstruction and camera jitter. Disable it when a case must isolate a post-temporal feature from temporal-history and jitter phase.

backend.description: Optional renderer pin. When present, VKR_HARNESS_RENDERER_BACKEND may confirm but cannot override it.

shadow_pcf_samples.description: Optional receiver tap-count override. Omission resolves to the selected preset's effective value.

shadow_split_lambda.description: Optional fixed cascade-split override. Omission resolves to the selected preset's effective value.

shadow_map_size.description: Optional per-cascade square map size. Omission resolves to the selected preset's effective value.

shadow_pcf_early_out.description: Optional nine-tap uniform-region early-out control. Omission resolves to the selected preset's effective value.

shadow_sdsm.description: Enables completed occupied-depth feedback for cascade split distribution. Omission keeps the preset's fixed-split default.

render_mode.description: Global shading mode for measured frames. Auxiliary debug captures execute as replay runs and do not change this value.

exposure_mode.description: Exposure policy. Automatic cases must also author the manual fallback and a measure-relative deterministic reset point.

manual_exposure.description: Positive linear multiplier in manual mode and the empty-histogram fallback in automatic mode.

exposure_compensation_ev.description: EV compensation applied to automatic exposure.

exposure_reset_frame.description: Required for automatic cases. Zero-based measure-relative frame before which adaptation history is explicitly reset.

bloom_enabled.description: Enables the scene-linear bloom chain. Omission keeps deterministic harness cases bloom-free.

bloom_intensity.description: Non-negative bloom weight applied before exposure.

gtao_enabled.description: Enables the GTAO ambient-visibility pass. Omission keeps deterministic harness cases GTAO-free.

gtao_radius.description: World-space GTAO sampling radius in the supported finite range.

ibl_probe_limit.description: Cold-boundary cap on packed local IBL probes. Omission uses the renderer maximum.

camera.description: Scripted camera. Poses are applied directly to VkrCamera; VkrCameraController is bypassed. Runtime semantic validation requires far_plane > near_plane and strictly increasing key times.

keys.description: Required by 'keyframes' and 'flythrough'. Ordered by t.

duration_seconds.description: Authored duration. Runtime duration is this value divided by the speed multiplier.

channel.description: Capture channel. Direct channels read a real graph image; logical debug channels re-render a settled frame with a different renderer global.

at_frame.description: Measured-frame index at which to capture. Capture additionally requires asset readiness; a manifest cannot opt out of that.

compare.description: Image comparison thresholds in a normalized [0,1] error domain. RGBA8 code values are divided by 255 and depth/shadow values are normalized device depth. Omitted fields fall back to the case-level block, then to these defaults. picking_ids ignores tolerances and always compares exactly.

max_pixel_delta.description: Largest permitted normalized component difference. A pixel fails if any component exceeds it.

max_mean_absolute_error.description: Largest permitted mean normalized absolute error over all scalar components.

max_failed_pixel_ratio.description: Fraction of pixels permitted to exceed max_pixel_delta.

emit_diff.description: Write a *_diff.png heat map beside the candidate.

assertion.description: A case-owned gate over one aggregated metric. Exactly one of max, min, or equals must be present. Case-local timing limits are investigative; authoritative performance thresholds belong to an accepted execution-profile baseline.

metric.description: Registered lowercase dotted metric name, for example cpu.render_submit_ms or draw.calls_issued.

tolerance.description: Permitted absolute deviation for 'equals'. Work-volume metrics are deterministic and should use the default.
